zh.cover.title: 温室气体排放计算报告
zh.report.A.section.summary: 温室气体排放计算摘要
zh.report.A.conclusion: 经计算确认，本组织温室气体排放的量化、监测和报告部分符合 GHG Protocol 的相关要求。
zh.report.A.prose.method: 排放量按活动水平数据乘以排放因子及全球增温潜势计算，量纲换算与计算口径见清册。
zh.report.A.prose.quality: 收集的数据核实其来源与准确性；清单的数据核算复核排放因子选择、计算方法、公式与单位换算；清单报告的核实检查报告完整性、格式与数据准确性。
zh.report.A.prose.uncertainty: 本报告采用定性分析方法，对活动水平、排放因子和仪器校正分级打分，并按排放量权重加权计算总评分。评分表与等级阈值由运行配置提供。
zh.report.B.draft_notice: 本文件为草稿。核查声明与保证结论须由授权核查员签署后方可生效。
zh.report.B.prose.objective: 本次核查针对报告边界内的温室气体排放量及其支撑证据进行独立复核。
zh.report.B.prose.criteria: 核查依据为组织采用的温室气体量化与报告准则，以及组织自行制定的相关制度。
zh.report.B.prose.procedures: 核查程序包括抽样、访谈、交叉核对与重新计算；具体记录由授权核查员提供。
zh.report.B.prose.statement_hint: 核查声明由授权核查员提供并由其承担责任，本 Skill 不生成、不推断、不补写结论性文字。

en.cover.title: Greenhouse Gas Inventory Report
en.report.A.conclusion: It is confirmed by calculation that the quantification, monitoring and reporting of the organization's GHG emissions partially comply with the relevant requirements of the GHG Protocol.
en.report.A.prose.method: Emissions are calculated as activity data multiplied by the emission factor and the global warming potential; dimensional conversions and accounting treatments are documented in the inventory.
en.report.A.prose.quality: Collected data are checked for source and accuracy; inventory calculations are reviewed for factor selection, method, formula and unit conversion; the report is checked for completeness, format and data accuracy.
en.report.A.prose.uncertainty: This report applies a qualitative analysis, grading activity data, emission factors and instrument calibration, then weighting the scores by emission share. Score tables and grade thresholds are supplied by the runtime configuration.
en.report.B.statement_placeholder: [To be completed by the authorized verifier after sign-off]
en.report.B.draft_notice: This document is a draft. The verification statement and assurance conclusion take effect only after signature by an authorized verifier.
en.report.B.prose.objective: This verification independently reviews GHG emissions within the reporting boundary and their supporting evidence.
en.report.B.prose.criteria: Verification is based on the GHG quantification and reporting criteria adopted by the organization and its own related procedures.
en.report.B.prose.procedures: Verification procedures include sampling, interviews, cross-checks and recalculation; detailed records are supplied by the authorized verifier.
en.report.B.prose.statement_hint: The verification statement is supplied by and remains the responsibility of the authorized verifier; this skill never generates, infers or completes conclusionary text.
